fix(camellia): align template modify tags payload

Summary:
- switch template-manage-page form state and modify payload to use `tags`
- stop sending legacy `labels` and `tag_list` fields on template modify
- allow template saves to proceed without any selected tags

Rationale:
- the backend contract for template modify now expects optional `tags`
- keeping the page on the legacy payload shape would break edit saves

Tests:
- just camellia typecheck
- just camellia build
